raw:
I remember saying goodbye to my longtime upstairs neighbor when she was moving. We had a final coffee together on the landing, with her moving boxes beside the stairwell. Those boxes made it feel real. I knew she was leaving, but sitting there with her, I started thinking about what it would be like not having her upstairs anymore.

There wasn’t anything unusual about having a coffee, and I think that was what made it sad. It was an ordinary thing, but this time it was a goodbye. I wanted to enjoy being there with her rather than spend the whole time thinking about her leaving. Still, I kept noticing the boxes. I was going to miss her.
